Title: Aditya and the Family

Cast

1. Aditya - 11 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Pallavi - 39 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Zoya - 10 years, friend
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Aditya stands in the courtyard. Pallavi and Zoya stand near him.]

Aditya: "What lovely weather!"

[Aditya dances to the music.]

Zoya: "Let's see."

[Aditya sings a song.]

Aditya: "One more time!"

[Aditya claps his hands.]

Pallavi: "I'm ready!"

[Aditya nods.]

Aditya: "How beautiful!"

[Aditya shakes his head.]

Pallavi: "Well done!"

[Aditya scratches his head.]

Aditya: "Really?"

[Aditya takes the bag from Mother.]

Zoya: "Oh wow!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Aditya stands in the living room. Pallavi stands near him.]

Aditya: "Let's begin."

[Aditya gulps down a glass of milk.]

Aditya: "Mom, look at this."

[Aditya sweeps the floor with a broom.]

Pallavi (surprised): "What happened?"

[Aditya reads a storybook.]

Aditya (laughing): "How beautiful!"

[Aditya watches cartoons on TV.]

Pallavi: "Yes, of course."

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

[It is raining heavily. Aditya stands in the courtyard. Pallavi stands near him.]

Pallavi: "Aditya, look over here."

[Aditya opens his umbrella.]

Aditya: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Aditya puts on his raincoat.]

Aditya: "Let's see."

[The rain stops.]

Pallavi: "Well done!"

Scene 4: The bedroom - Day

[Aditya stands in the bedroom. Pallavi stands near him.]

Aditya: "What a nice place."

[Aditya yawns loudly.]

Aditya: "That's great!"

[Aditya stretches his arms above his head.]

Aditya: "One more time!"

[Aditya goes to bed and falls asleep.]

Aditya: "One more time!"

[Aditya sits on the edge of the bed.]

Aditya: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
